AsymmetryMechanism.description: Section 2, 3, 5. One distinct information-asymmetry mechanism, individuated by its causal process and its detection surface, not by a label. A mechanism with no detection surface cannot be instrumented (Section 2 validity criterion 3), so detection_surface is required.

cynefin_domain.description: Section 4.1. The Cynefin domain that sets the detection action mode.

detection_surface.description: Section 2 criterion 3. The observable signals in the coordination record that indicate the mechanism is active.

id.description: The mechanism handle (for example, positional, interpretive, synthetic_coordination).

mechanism.description: Section 2 criterion 1. The distinct causal process by which advantage accumulates through informational position.

orthogonal_at_mechanism.description: Section 2 criterion 4. True when the mechanism is individuated at the level of causal process, so its presence does not entail another's.

remediation_direction.description: Section 5 Scope. The structural remediation direction the mechanism implies; a pointer, since IACS defers the remediation architecture.

status.description: Section 5. Whether the mechanism is primary, a fully specified extension, or a scoped-out stub (not usable in a conforming detection architecture).

sub_pattern.description: A named sub-pattern of this mechanism (for example, Distributed Monoculture, Coordination Record Asymmetry, Consensus Manufacturing).

AsymmetryMechanism.title: AsymmetryMechanism

Classification.description: Section 6. One classification of a coordination record against a mechanism.

cynefin_domain.description: Section 4.1. The Cynefin domain classification applied, with its action mode.

detection_signals_observed.description: The specific detection-surface signals observed in the record.

mechanism.description: The handle of the mechanism assigned (references an applicable_mechanisms entry).

Classification.title: Classification

ConformanceAnswer.description: Per-obligation answer; silence is not one of the values.
ConformanceAnswer.title: ConformanceAnswer

ConformanceDeclaration.description: The per-obligation conformance answers on the face. There is deliberately no overall or total field: conformance is per-obligation, mirroring the suite's refusal to collapse a profile into a single number.
ConformanceDeclaration.title: ConformanceDeclaration

CynefinDomain.description: Section 4.1. The Cynefin domains and their detection action modes.
CynefinDomain.title: CynefinDomain

IACSArchitecture.description: The system-level detection architecture and tier. Higher-tier fields are optional in the schema; the checker requires them at the tiers the register specifies.

applicability_inventory.description: Section 6 Assessed. A class applicability inventory naming applicable, partial, and not-applicable mechanisms with a present, assumed, or absent detection state.

audience_baseline_declared.description: Section 6 Instrumented. The audience linguistic, epistemic, and ontological baseline, required when Descriptive Capacity asymmetry is applicable in a document-production context.

classification_process_documented.description: Section 6 Operational. A documented classification process per applicable mechanism.

cynefin_documented.description: Section 6 Instrumented. A documented Cynefin domain classification per mechanism with the matching action mode.

detection_architecture_present.description: Section 6 Instrumented. A real-time detection architecture instrumenting the surfaces, disclosed to participants.

IACSArchitecture.title: IACSArchitecture

IACSConformanceRecord.description: A system's declaration of the mechanisms it instruments, its classifications, its detection architecture, and its conformance.

applicable_mechanisms.description: Section 6. The mechanisms the system identifies as applicable, rendered as structured objects (the code system, not a label list). Each carries its causal process, detection surface, orthogonality, status, Cynefin domain, and remediation direction.

architecture.description: The system's detection architecture and adopted tier.

classifications.description: Section 6. The classifications the system has produced, each referencing a mechanism and the signals observed.

conformance.description: Per-obligation conformance answers on the face; no total.

IACSConformanceRecord.title: IACSConformanceRecord

MechanismStatus.description: Section 5. The specification status of a mechanism.
